summary: Frontend-only regression for iteration 5 (density pass). Cleared localStorage 'trias.state.v1' before each login. Ran 27 Playwright checks against the public preview URL; all 27 passed. Coverage: (T1) /patients top bar is a single compact row containing patient-count-label, patient-search-input, filter-toggle-btn and new-patient-btn (y-center spread 18px — same visual row) and the old big header/filter block is gone. (T2) filter-panel is not present in DOM until filter-toggle-btn is clicked; when open it contains patient-village-filter, patient-status-filter, patient-outcome-filter and clear-patient-filters-btn. (T3) applying Status=Confirmed narrows count '6 records' → '2 of 6 records', the filter-toggle-btn badge shows '1', combining with search 'Elijah' further narrows to '1 of 6 records', and clear-patient-filters-btn resets both the panel state and the record count. (T4) patient card meta line shows the full pattern 'Age · Sex · Weight · DOB YYYY-MM-DD · Blood X · Village, District' — e.g. Elijah Waim '7y · Male · 21kg · DOB 2019-05-12 · Blood O+ · Bilbil, Madang District' and Grace Waim (registered without a DOB) shows 'DOB 1992-05-12 · Blood Unknown' (derived from age). (T5) At 1600x900 exactly 5 patient cards fit above the fold (was ~3 before density pass). (T6) patient-card-<id> is a <div role=button>, not an <a>, so the previous <a>-in-<a> React hydration warning is gone; call-btn hrefs are tel:+phone and whatsapp-btn hrefs are https://wa.me/<digits>; card click navigates to /patients/<id>. (T7) Patient record page shows a single record-patient-header strip that contains the record-patient-header-photo, name, status badge, patient/episode IDs, and a chip list record-patient-header-details with DOB, Age, Sex, Weight, Height, Blood, Phone, Email, Village and Province; record-actions (Patients / Suspect / New encounter / Call / WhatsApp) is nested INSIDE the header; the old demographic-card testid is gone and there is no duplicated 'Patient record' h1. (T8) Encounter page shows encounter-patient-header at the top with exit-encounter-btn on the right, disease text 'scabies' in the header, and the previous large AppShell title/subtitle block is gone. (T9) section-toggle-2/3/9 open and close section bodies correctly; ivermectin dose 4.2 mg for Elijah (21kg) still appears in the treatment section. (T10) At 390x844 documentElement.scrollWidth is 390 (no horizontal overflow) on /patients, /patients/:id and /patients/:id/encounter/scabies; Elijah's full name renders (not clipped) and the outcome text ('Cured / clinically resolved') appears in the mobile meta line. (T11) At 820x1180 /patients scrollWidth is 820 (no overflow). (T12) Mary (province scope, Madang) sees exactly 4 patients — Elijah, Grace, Peter, Rita — and NOT Lucy Sipa (East Sepik) or Samuel Bau (Morobe). No page errors thrown, no <a>-in-<a> warning anymore, only 2 minor Radix Select controlled/uncontrolled warnings from the filter selects.

console_warnings: Radix UI Select on the filter panel: 'Select is changing from uncontrolled to controlled' and back — the SelectField placeholder path passes value="" which Radix Select treats as uncontrolled, then a non-empty value flips it to controlled. Harmless but noisy. Consider passing undefined instead of '' when nothing is selected, or wrapping in defaultValue.

action_items: (LOW) Silence the Radix Select controlled/uncontrolled warnings by passing undefined (not '') as the value when no filter is chosen, or by using SelectField's defaultValue/onValueChange combo consistently.
critical_code_review_comments: PatientHeader.jsx renders 10 flex chips inline (DOB/Age/Sex/Weight/Height/Blood/Phone/Email/Village/Province). At small tablet widths (≈820px) with a long phone/email/village this row can wrap 3 lines, which is fine, but consider truncating Email or hiding it behind a 'More' popover to keep the strip to 1–2 lines. Not a bug, purely density polish for next iteration.

Patients.jsx keeps the record-count label under the h1 in the same flex child — at very narrow widths (<360px) the count wraps under the label. Not observed at 390x844 (no overflow) but worth verifying at 320px.

SelectField placeholder pattern: passing value="" causes Radix Select controlled/uncontrolled warnings on first render. Prefer value={village || undefined} in Patients.jsx SelectField props (or fix at SelectField level).
store.addUser/addFacility/saveEncounter id generation via Date.now()/Math.random() (carried over from iter-4) — still not fixed; on fast double-clicks a duplicate id is possible.
PatientRecord.jsx 'Manage household & contacts' still routes via the disease chooser (setChooser(true)) instead of a dedicated household page (carried over from iter-4).
PatientHeader renders <dt>/<dd> pairs inside a <div>, which is invalid HTML (dt/dd must be direct children of <dl>). Currently silent but would fail strict a11y linting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Density pass ships cleanly. Key testids introduced/renamed this iteration: patient-header (default), record-patient-header, encounter-patient-header, <testid>-photo, <testid>-details, filter-toggle-btn, filter-panel, exit-encounter-btn, record-actions. Removed: demographic-card, record-patient-photo (now record-patient-header-photo). Filter panel is not in DOM until toggled — assert on count()==0 not visibility. Filter-toggle-btn shows a numeric badge when activeFilters>0. Elijah's patient id is P-2026-001001 and ivermectin dose is 4.2 mg. Admin login lands on /mis, not /patients — navigate explicitly. Ignore the 2 Radix Select controlled/uncontrolled warnings (SelectField placeholder path).
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs. Prior <a>-in-<a> hydration warning (iter-4) is resolved by making the patient card a <div role=button>. Remaining noise is a Radix Select controlled/uncontrolled warning from the filter panel's SelectField when its value is an empty string.
